description: Asks before a native Read of an expensive format (.pdf, .html, .xlsx, .docx, .pptx) — see read_cost.py. A mod (read-cost-hold/register.tsx) holds the Read in a band above the prompt with one button per outcome — convert to Markdown (only when markitdown is installed), read as-is, or deny; an unanswered hold falls back to the hook's ask.
